text.intro:
The Dented Bell runs karaoke on Tuesdays. Attendance is loyal; talent is not.
Five singers are involved. Determine each singer's slot, song, drink and reception.
- **Singer**: Mercy, Vikram, Bogdan, Caitriona and Annalise.
- **Running order** (listed from earlier to later): slot one, slot two, slot three, slot four and slot five.
- **Song**: a sea shanty, a power ballad, a rap performed entirely from memory, a disco standard and a maudlin folk song.
- **Drink**: a lime and soda; a double whisky; a rum and coke; a pint of mild; and a cider in a plastic cup.
- **Reception**: scattered applause, polite silence, one heckler, a singalong and a standing ovation.
Every singer has a different slot, song, drink and reception, so within each category every item is used exactly once.
clues: At least one of the following holds, and possibly more than one: (a) The singer who performs a power ballad is later than slot four in slot order. (b) Slot one is exactly one slot earlier than the singer who performs a disco standard, with no slot in between.

If (a) holds then (b) also holds, but not necessarily the reverse: (a) The singer who orders a pint of mild and the singer who gets one heckler are exactly one slot apart in slot order, in one direction or the other. (b) The singer who orders a double whisky sings in slot three.
The singer who gets a singalong and slot five are exactly two slots apart in slot order.

At least one of the following holds, and possibly more than one: (a) The singer who orders a lime and soda performs a disco standard. (b) The singer who performs a power ballad does not sing in slot four.
One of Annalise and slot two sits at an odd-numbered slot and the other at an even-numbered slot.
The singer who performs a sea shanty falls somewhere between Annalise and Mercy in slot order.
At least one of the following holds, and possibly more than one: (a) Caitriona orders a rum and coke. (b) Bogdan does not order a double whisky.

If (a) holds then (b) also holds, but not necessarily the reverse: (a) The singer who gets scattered applause and the singer who performs a rap performed entirely from memory are exactly four slots apart in slot order. (b) The singer who performs a sea shanty is earlier than the singer who gets polite silence in slot order.
The singer who orders a pint of mild is earlier than Mercy in slot order.
The singer who gets scattered applause and the singer who performs a disco standard are exactly one slot apart in slot order, in one direction or the other.
The following is NOT true: The singer who gets one heckler and Caitriona are exactly one slot apart in slot order, in one direction or the other.

At least one of the following holds, and possibly more than one: (a) The singer who orders a pint of mild and the singer who gets one heckler are exactly one slot apart in slot order, in one direction or the other. (b) The singer who orders a rum and coke and Caitriona are exactly two slots apart in slot order.
The singer who gets a singalong and the singer who performs a power ballad are exactly one slot apart in slot order, in one direction or the other.
Vikram is earlier than the singer who orders a pint of mild in slot order.
The following is NOT true: The singer who performs a rap performed entirely from memory is earlier than the singer who orders a rum and coke in slot order.
Mercy does not get one heckler.
The following is NOT true: The singer who orders a double whisky and the singer who gets a singalong are exactly one slot apart in slot order, in one direction or the other.
